_comment: Example seed for a single-player BTD2 practice match, for bench/jev_flow_live.py --seed-file. REVIEW BEFORE USE: the approved_region is a fraction of the game window and must cover only your own half of the map; W/E/R are the tower hotkeys observed locally for tower slots 1-3 and may differ in your keybind settings.

actions.target_description: an empty buildable spot on the player's own half of the map, away from the track and from other towers
actions.placement_check: Is the tower ghost under the cursor shown as valid, with no 'Wrong Side!' or red invalid-position indicator?
